ctx.x: Did you ever know Frank Sebastian?

Frank Sebastian? Sure, I did. He come down to... when Frank Sebastian started to open a nightclub, they come down to the music store, and they wanted to know if I had a band or anything, you know, and whether I could get...and he looked up on the wall, and there was Duke Ellington's big advertisement sheet, you know, like I had my band in there? The Cotton Club. So, he said, "That's the name we going to name it: Cotton Club."
